value.rationale: The output gives a sharp all-order correction to an explicitly published analytical significance calibration: a nominal 5% two-sided Gaussian test has asymptotic null rejection 1.57944924024e-6 at theta=2. The corrected n=100 cutoff 0.1502481–0.1797519 is close to the paper’s independent Monte Carlo quantiles 0.1497–0.1792, whereas the printed-variance normal interval is much wider. This consequential statistical calibration is not merely an arbitrary numerical gain; generic spacings facts are not claimed novel.
